theater: 鴨綠江東岸與高麗北境

battle.name: 高麗契丹戰爭
battle.theater: 鴨綠江東岸與高麗北境
battle.brief: 993年遼聖宗率大軍渡鴨綠江，攻破高麗西京平壤外的蓬山陣，兵鋒抵安戴鎮受阻，雙方在江東議和。往後二十六年遼三度南下，1018年蕭排押率十萬眾再攻江東六城，卻在慈州、三橋川被姜邯贊全殲。卡面希臘重步兵並未出戰役，然高麗劍車結陣與遼騎突入盾線，正是重步兵互相遮蔽立陣的同一條戰術邏輯。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰的兩方是十世紀末葉的契丹遼朝與高麗王國。遼是契丹建國、916年耶律阿保機統一各部後形成的帝國，聖宗耶律隆緒在位時國勢正盛：北面官仍行契丹舊制，掌兵馬、斂選與諸部帳；南面官則用漢式衙門，處理漢地州縣與漢軍。遼軍的骨幹是契丹本部騎兵，分為皮室、屬珊與帳官等諸部，另有漢軍步兵、弩手，另有渤海系與女真等歸附部落的行伍；出征大軍設牙帳為中樞，前鋒、中軍、後軍分道推進，統軍之號由五院、六院諸部與北面都統分掌，攻城則雜以臨時編成的漢軍與部伍。高麗方面是李氏王國，景德王與顯宗在位，先後以中書門下平章事執政，州郡之上設六道觀察使與兵馬都統使，兵役分弓弩手、騎兵、步軍與水軍：弓弩手由各州縣常置，是高麗倚重的投射骨幹；騎兵以豐州、興德軍等處為基地；城防則依各鎭與州城，鴨綠江東岸的興化、龜州、通州、郭州，加上西京平壤與開京，構成一條北境防線。雙方的交鋒並不局限在邊境：993年遼軍越江直抵西京，1010年再陷開京，1018年攻至興化、慈州一線，戰線始終落在高麗北境與江東山地之間；而高麗與北宋結盟、遼與西北的西夏及渤海遺部往來，又使這場邊境衝突牽入更大的區域格局。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the Khitan Liao dynasty and the Goryeo kingdom in the late tenth century. The Liao was the empire the Khitans built after Yelü Abaoji unified their tribes in 916, and under Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, it was at the height of its power: the Northern Administration still followed Khitan custom, taking charge of troops, appointments and the tribal households, while the Southern Administration used Chinese-style bureaus to run the Chinese prefectures and the Han army. The backbone of the Liao army was Khitan cavalry organised in the Pishi, the Shushans and the various banner corps, supplemented by Han infantry and crossbowmen, by Bohai elements and by the levies of Jurchen and other submitted tribes. A field army made its tent the hub of operations, with vanguard, central and rear columns advancing by separate routes, and command was divided among the Five and Six Headquarters and the Northern command posts of the Han army, with improvised Han and tribal contingents mixed in for the siege operations. Goryeo on the other side was the Yi-ruled kingdom, under King Chongjong and then King Hyeonjong, with the Secretariat and the Department of State Affairs governing the realm through the chancellor, and above the prefectures and counties six circuits each with an inspector and a military commissioner; the levies were divided into crossbowmen, cavalry, foot and navy. The crossbowmen, permanently maintained by every prefecture and county, were the backbone of Goryeo's missile arm; the cavalry were based at places such as Fengzhou and the Xingde army; and the line of defence rested on the frontier garrisons, the towns of Xinghua, Guizhou, Tongzhou and Guozhou on the east bank of the Yalu, together with the western capital of Pyongyang and the capital of Kaijing. The fighting was not confined to the frontier. In 993 the Liao crossed the river and struck at the western capital; in 1010 they took Kaijing; in 1018 they reached the Xinghua and Cizhou areas, so that the front always lay between the northern districts of Goryeo and the hill country east of the river. And because Goryeo was allied with the Northern Song, while the Liao had dealings with the Western Xia in the north-west and with the Bohai remnant, this border war was drawn into a wider regional pattern.
people: 遼方主導這場戰爭的是聖宗耶律隆緒：他自982年即位後先於985年嘗試南伐，993年再以大軍越江，1010年親率四十萬眾攻陷開京，1018年仍遣蕭排押出師，江東六城的問題前後牽動二十六年，他從未放棄用兵解決。第一次戰役的遼軍主將蕭通寧最為關鍵：他率先鋒攻破蓬山陣、擒高麗上軍使，卻在安戴鎮受阻，識破武力征服高麗的代價太高，轉而提出議和，並在交涉中力主要高麗稱臣；同一場戰爭的另一邊，1010年遼聖宗所遣特使韓杞在勸降西京時被守將卓思政殺死，說明遼使節與高麗朝廷之間的裂痕已深。遼軍名將耶律世良於1016年統軍深入郭州以西一線，途中病逝，軍遂退；蕭敵烈、蕭屈烈、蕭合卓先後統兵攻通州、興化；1018年的統帥蕭排押兵敗全軍覆沒，隨即被免職。高麗一方，景德王面對稱臣要求而遣使交涉；內史侍御史徐熈任中軍使，在談判中逐條駁斥蕭通寧的宗主權主張，主張兩國平行，並以高句麗舊土平土盡屬高麗來駁斥遼方，迫得雙方最終只能以東西平坐的平等方式談判；上軍使尙中朴、良綏與下軍使侒亮指揮第一線戰鬥。1010年康兆等人弒殺顯宗，反被遼聖宗拿來當作問罪的名分，成為第二場戰爭的導火線。1018年決戰的指揮者是平章事姜邯贊任上元帥、大將軍姜民瞻任副：姜邯贊重兵屯興化，以逸待勞，又以騎兵於三橋川破遼軍萬人；姜民瞻在慈州側擊，全殲遼軍萬餘。鄭神勇、周演、高積余、趙戈等分守興化、通州、宣和、定遠；楊規、李守和死守興化七日，楊規更以孤軍旬月七戰，斬獲並奪回被擄三萬餘口，最後力竭戰死；卓思政拒守西京，殺遼使韓杞；金叔興、保良、鄭成等在龜州、石嶺一路追擊退兵之遼軍。
peopleEn: The man who directed this war on the Liao side was Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu. Since his accession in 982 he had probed south in 985, crossed the river again with a great army in 993, personally led forty thousand men against Kaijing in 1010, and was still sending out Xiao Paiya with ten thousand men in 1018; the question of the six towns east of the river kept the matter alive for twenty-six years, and he never gave up solving it by arms. The Liao commander in the first war, Xiao Tongning, was the most decisive figure of all: he broke the Pengshan line with his vanguard and took the Goryeo commander-in-chief alive, but was checked at Andae town, saw that the price of subduing Goryeo by force would be too high, turned instead to negotiation, and pressed in the talks for Goryeo to acknowledge itself a vassal. On the other side of the same war, the Liao envoy Han Qi, sent by Shengzong in 1010 to demand the surrender of the western capital, was killed by its governor, Jang Sajeong, which shows how deeply the rift between Liao envoys and the Goryeo court had opened. The Liao general Yelü Sheliang led the army deep beyond Guozhou in 1016 and died of illness on the way, whereupon the army withdrew; Xiao Dilie, Xiao Qulie and Xiao Hezhuo in turn led columns against Tongzhou and Xinghua; and the commander in 1018, Xiao Paiya, was beaten in a total rout and was dismissed from his post. On the Goryeo side, King Chongjong sent envoys in answer to the demand for submission. Xu Xuan, the Naeseong Uisasa, the censor, served as central commander and demolished the Liao claim of suzerainty point by point in the negotiations, insisting that the two states stood level, and refuted the Liao argument with the observation that the old lands of Goguryeo were level ground and belonged in full to Goryeo, forcing both sides to a negotiation conducted with the two parties seated east and west on equal terms. Shang Zhongpu and Liang Sui served as senior commanders and Yan Liang as junior commander, and they directed the fighting on the first line. In 1010 Kang Zhao and the others murdered King Hyeonjong, and the Liao seized on the regicide as a casus belli for the second war. The commanders of the decisive year were the chancellor Jiang Hanzan as chief marshal and the general Jiang Minzhan as his deputy: Jiang Hanzan massed his troops at Xinghua to wait for the enemy, and broke ten thousand Liao troops with his cavalry at the Sanqiao river; Jiang Minzhan struck the flank at Cizhou and annihilated more than ten thousand Liao men. Zheng Shenyong, Zhou Yan, Gao Jiyu and Zhao Ge held Xinghua, Tongzhou, Xuanhe and Dingyuan in turn; Yang Gui and Li Shouhe held Xinghua for seven days, and Yang Gui fought seven battles in ten days with a single detachment, cutting off the Liao and recovering more than thirty thousand captives before he was killed at last, spent; Jang Sajeong held the western capital and killed the Liao envoy Han Qi; and Kim Seok-heung, Boryang and Jeong Seong pursued the withdrawing Liao army at Guizhou and Shiling.
kits: 卡面這名希臘重步兵（hoplite）並沒有出現在十世紀的鴨綠江邊。他是公元前五世紀的希臘城邦重裝步兵：以青銅圓盾、鎧甲、短劍與長矛組成方陣，盾牌彼此遮蔽，隊形的重心不在個人而在整列的互相保護。把他放進這場戰爭的裝備表，是因為雙方在鴨綠江與江東山地的攻防裡反覆面對的，正是同一個問題——重步兵能否靠互相遮蔽站住陣線。實際上陣的是遼軍的騎兵主力：人著皮甲或鎖子甲，佩遼式長刀、標槍與短弓，靠馬匹的機動衝擊人馬未結陣的敵軍，並以大量箭矢覆蓋對方陣前；攻城時用投石機、床子弩與撞車，野戰則以箭雨和追擊消耗潰散之敵。另一邊的高麗軍以弓弩為投射骨幹，州縣常置的弓弩手用穿甲箭在盾牆後放箭，前面以槍、長刀與盾組成步兵線；關鍵裝備是劍車，即以車身與車上長槍排成的車陣，正是通州之戰中高麗隔水列陣、屢破遼軍先鋒的裝備。城防方面，興化鎮、安戴鎮與西京平壤依靠夯土城牆、女牆、甕城與門樓，圍城七日不下的守備多賴弓弩壓制與夜襲反擊，而非攻城器械。渡江與運輸靠舟船、牛馬車隊；1015年遼在鴨綠江上架長橋，連接來遠城與義州，使騎兵與輜重得以直接過江，說明橋樑與糧道對遼軍的意義遠勝攻城塔；反過來，高麗的守城者正是靠斷糧與側擊，削弱遠征之師。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card never stood on the bank of the Yalu in the tenth century. He was a heavy infantryman of the Greek city states of the fifth century BC: a phalanx of bronze round shields, body armour, short swords and spears, the shields overlapping one another so that the weight of the formation lay not in the individual but in the mutual protection of the whole line. He belongs in the equipment table of this war because the question the two sides kept returning to on the Yalu and in the hills east of the river was precisely the same one: can heavy infantry hold a line by shielding one another. What actually fought was the Liao cavalry. The horsemen wore leather or mail, carried Liao-style sabres, lances and short bows, and used the mobility of the horse to charge troops that had not yet closed their ranks, covering the enemy's front with massed arrows; for sieges they used stone-throwers, bed crossbows and battering rams, and in the field they wore the enemy down with arrow showers and pursuit. Goryeo's army, on the other side, rested its missile arm on the bow and crossbow: the crossbowmen permanently maintained by every prefecture and county shot piercing arrows from behind a wall of shields, with spears, sabres and shields in front of them making up the line of foot. The critical piece of equipment was the sword-cart, a formation of waggon bodies and the long spears fixed to them, and it was with this that Goryeo arrayed itself across the water at Tongzhou and broke the Liao vanguard more than once. On the defensive side, the towns of Xinghua, Andae and the western capital of Pyongyang relied on rammed-earth walls, parapets, barbicans and gate towers, and the defence that held out for seven days depended on crossbow fire and on counter-attacks by night rather than on siege engines. Crossing the river and the carriage of supplies depended on boats and on ox and horse teams; in 1015 the Liao built a long bridge over the Yalu linking Lailing with Uiju, so that cavalry and baggage could pass directly over the water, which shows that for the Liao army the bridge and the supply line mattered far more than any tower. Inverted, it was the garrison that won by cutting the food route and attacking the flanks, and so bleeding a distant army.
tactics: 遼軍的戰術核心是騎兵的三個動作：遠距離以弓矢覆蓋、逼近時以密集騎鋒衝擊對方尚未合攏的步兵線、衝破之後立即縱騎追擊。993年的蓬山之戰是一次正面撞陣：雙方在平壤附近列陣，蕭通寧以先鋒破高麗前陣、擒其上軍使，卻無法把突破口擴成全線崩潰；安戴鎮一役高麗以城守與弩手反擊，遼軍不得近。1010年第二役，遼軍渡江後分兵：二十萬屯麟州，聖宗親率其餘二十萬攻通州，康兆隔水布陣、以劍車列陣，先後破遼軍數陣，最後仍被先鋒耶律盆奴突破陣線，損失三萬餘眾；遼軍轉攻安州、西京，1011年1月1日攻陷開京，焚中興寺塔與宮室，但因興化、龜州、通州、西京四處仍在抵抗，無法追擊南逃的顯宗，1月11日班師。撤退路上是高麗的追擊戰：金叔興、保良於龜州斬萬餘級，楊規在無老代、石嶺、余里站、艾田連戰皆捷，旬月七戰，奪回被擄三萬餘口，遼軍渡江時多溺死者。1018年第三次，高麗換了更講究的節奏：姜邯贊以逸待勞，重兵屯興化，等蕭排押的十萬眾抵達再出；三橋川一戰，騎兵先破遼軍萬人；蕭排押繞開姜邯贊直趨開京，途中在慈州被姜民瞻側翼擊潰，糧道被切，幾乎全軍覆沒，生還者僅數千人。外交也是戰術：993年的平行談判、1011年後遼要求高麗歸還鴨綠江東岸六城並要求顯宗朝覲，都是用來取代兵力的手段。
tacticsEn: The core of Liao tactics was three movements of the cavalry: covering the enemy with arrows from a distance, charging with a dense wedge of riders against an enemy infantry line that had not yet closed up, and riding the broken enemy down the moment the line was pierced. The battle of Pengshan in 993 was a head-on collision of formations: the two sides deployed in front of Pyongyang, Xiao Tongning broke the Goryeo front with his vanguard and took the Goryeo commander-in-chief alive, but could not turn the breach into a general collapse; at the town of Andae, Goryeo replied with a garrison and its crossbowmen, and the Liao could not come up. In the second war of 1010 the Liao divided after crossing the river: two hundred thousand men were posted at Linzhou, and Shengzong himself led the other two hundred thousand against Tongzhou. Kang Zhao arrayed his troops across the water with his sword-carts, broke several Liao formations in succession, and was finally broken himself when the vanguard of Yelü Pennu pierced the line, at a cost of more than thirty thousand men. The Liao turned to Anju and to the western capital, took Kaijing on 1 January 1011 and burned the pagoda of the Zhongxingsi and the palace quarter, but with Xinghua, Guizhou, Tongzhou and the western capital all still resisting, they could not pursue the king who had fled south, and on 11 January they broke camp. The road back was a Goryeo pursuit: Kim Seok-heung and Boryang cut down more than ten thousand at Guizhou, and Yang Gui fought seven battles in a row at Wulaodai, Shiling, the Yuli station and Aitian, fighting seven times in ten days, recovering more than thirty thousand captives, and many of the Liao drowned as they forded the Yalu. In 1018 Goryeo used a more deliberate rhythm: Jiang Hanzan waited at ease with his mass at Xinghua until Xiao Paiya's hundred thousand had arrived, broke ten thousand of them with the cavalry at the Sanqiao river, and when Xiao Paiya turned away from Jiang Hanzan to march on Kaijing he was cut up in the flank at Cizhou by Jiang Minzhan, his supply line cut, and almost the whole army destroyed, only a few thousand escaping. Diplomacy was itself a weapon: the level negotiation of 993, and the Liao demands after 1011 for the return of the six towns east of the Yalu and for King Hyeonjong to come to court, were means substituted for troops.
data: 可核對的數字分史載與推算兩類，須分辨。993年遼軍渡鴨綠江，記為「八十萬」；1010年聖宗南伐記為「四十萬」；這類數目出自《遼史》《高麗史》的敘述，歷來被視為誇張的約數，實際作戰兵力應遠少於此，遼軍主力是契丹騎兵，攻城時靠臨時編成的漢軍與部伍；戰役中「十萬」「五萬五千」等較小數目反而較為可據。1015年遼以五萬五千精兵攻定遠、興化二城；同年攻寧州，記遼兵陣亡七百餘，高麗鄭神勇等六名將領陣亡。1016年高麗在郭州以西一線陣亡數萬，遼軍深入至《高麗史》所記的「南海」一線，耶律世良病逝而退。1018年遼以十萬眾、高麗以二十餘萬相拒；慈州一戰，遼軍被殲萬餘，生還者僅數千人。守城與游擊的數目可作對照：1010年楊規以七百人加募千餘人夜襲郭州，盡誅城內六千餘遼軍，救出男女七千餘口；龜州斬萬餘級，無老代斬二千餘級，梨樹追至石嶺斬二千五百餘級，余里站斬千餘級，艾田斬千餘級；興化被圍七日、1017年再被圍九日皆不克。遠征的代價亦見於記錄：遼軍撤退時渡鴨綠江，多人溺死。時間上，993年正月女真先報、十月開戰；1010年11月再渡江；1018年10月出師，均選在秋冬，糧秣與牧馬尚可，卻不利於攻城。距離上，自鴨綠江至開京、開京至慈州與興化一線，山地阻隔，遼軍的糧道長度遠超高麗守軍的補給線，這正是姜邯贊選擇屯兵待敵的理由。1019年8月雙方議和；1022年遼冊封顯宗為高麗國王，食邑萬戶、食實封千戶；1117年3月遼亡，許王耶律寧將來遠城與保州交予高麗；1126年12月金廷將保州歸還高麗。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into two classes, the recorded and the estimated, and they must be kept apart. In 993 the Liao army crossing the Yalu is given as eight hundred thousand; the campaign of 1010 under Shengzong is given as four hundred thousand. Such figures come from the narratives of the Liao Shi and the Goryeosa, have always been taken to be inflated round numbers, and the actual field strength must have been far smaller. The core of the Liao army was Khitan cavalry, with improvised Han and tribal contingents raised for the sieges; the smaller figures such as one hundred thousand or fifty-five thousand are on the whole the more reliable. In 1015 the Liao took fifty-five thousand picked troops against the two towns of Dingyuan and Xinghua; the same year, in the attack on Ningzhou, the Liao are recorded as losing more than seven hundred men while six Goryeo commanders including Zheng Shenyong were killed. In 1016 Goryeo lost tens of thousands in the line west of Guozhou, the Liao pushed as far as the point the Goryeosa calls Nanhai, and withdrew when Yelü Sheliang died of illness. In 1018 the Liao brought a hundred thousand men against more than two hundred thousand Goryeo troops; in the fighting at Cizhou the Liao force was destroyed to the number of more than ten thousand, and only a few thousand came back. The figures for the defence and the harassment can be set against these. In 1010 Yang Gui, with seven hundred men and more than a thousand recruits, attacked Guozhou by night, killed the whole of the six thousand odd Liao troops in the town and brought out more than seven thousand men and women. At Guizhou more than ten thousand were cut down, at Wulaodai more than two thousand, in the chase from Yushu to Shiling more than two thousand five hundred, at the Yuli station more than a thousand and at Aitian more than a thousand. Xinghua was invested for seven days, and again for nine days in 1017, and was not taken. The cost of the expedition shows in the record as well: many of the Liao drowned fording the Yalu as they withdrew. In time, the Jurchen gave warning in the first month of 993 and the war opened in the tenth; the river was crossed again in the eleventh month of 1010; and the army marched out in the tenth month of 1018. All three were chosen in autumn and winter, when fodder and grazing were still available but sieges were out of season. In distance, the route from the Yalu to Kaijing and from Kaijing to the Cizhou and Xinghua line crosses broken hills, so that the Liao supply line was far longer than the Goryeo one, which is precisely why Jiang Hanzan chose to sit in his masses and wait. In August 1019 the two sides made peace. In 1022 the Liao enfeoffed King Hyeonjong as King of Goryeo, with a food allowance of ten thousand households and an actual grant of one thousand. In March 1117, with the Liao falling to the Jin, Prince Xu Yelü Ning handed Lailing and Baozhou over to Goryeo; and in December 1126 the Jin court returned Baozhou to Goryeo.
cause: 打起來的原因分近因與遠因。遠因是渤海：926年契丹滅渤海國，舊土與遺民成了一道懸案，遼與高麗都想把這塊地連同東北海邊的部眾收進自己懷裡；925年高麗遣使到契丹、契丹屢次送馬而高麗拒絕回聘，成為交惡的早期記錄。近因是鴨綠江江口的城堡：988至993年間遼征女真與定安國，991年2月在江口修築威州、振化、來遠三城，越過了高麗的北境線；遼要求高麗稱臣納貢並交出所占的高句麗舊土，高麗拒絕，986年更與北宋結盟，遼視之為背叛。名分之爭的底層，是遊牧的遼與農耕的高麗都要一份對方的臣服憑據，徐熈在993年談判中把這層意思講得很直白。往後三次用兵，理由層層加碼：第一次是要高麗稱臣；第二次多了高麗內部政變的名分，1010年康兆弒殺顯宗，遼聖宗自稱為王報仇；第三次則是明確的領土要求——1011年撤軍時江東六城叛應遼，遼幾度交涉無果，1014年起連年出兵要把興化、通州、郭州、龜州、定遠等城收回，並在江東建保州城，把防線推到江東。戰略上，遼並非沒有弱點：騎兵在平原上是強項，卻不擅長越江與在山道中維持糧道，一旦深入便要靠夏秋的牧養與大量的車馬；高麗則以本土防守、弩手密度與地形的縱深換時間。
causeEn: The reasons for the war divide into distant causes and immediate ones. The distant cause is Bohai. In 926 the Khitans destroyed the kingdom of Bohai, and the old land and the displaced people became a standing question, for both the Liao and Goryeo wanted to draw that territory and the tribes along the north-eastern seaboard into their own hands. In 925 Goryeo sent an embassy to the Khitans, and the Khitans sent horses again and again while Goryeo refused to send an envoy back; that is the earliest record of the quarrel. The immediate cause is the forts at the mouth of the Yalu. Between 988 and 993 the Liao campaigned against the Jurchen and against the state of Jeongan, and in the second month of 991 they built the forts of Wi, Chin and Lailing at the river mouth, crossing the northern line of Goryeo. The Liao demanded that Goryeo acknowledge vassalage, pay tribute and give up the old Goguryeo territory it held; Goryeo refused, and in 986 entered into an alliance with the Northern Song, which the Liao read as betrayal. Beneath the dispute over forms of address lay the fact that a pastoral Liao and an agrarian Goryeo each wanted a written token of the other's submission, and Xu Xuan made that point in plain terms during the negotiations of 993. The reasons then hardened with each round of fighting. The first war was to make Goryeo acknowledge itself a vassal. The second acquired a new warrant from Goryeo's own coup: in 1010 Kang Su murdered King Hyeonjong, and Shengzong claimed to be avenging his king. The third was an explicit territorial demand. When the Liao withdrew in 1011, the six towns east of the river rose against them; several diplomatic exchanges produced nothing; and from 1014 the Liao campaigned year after year to recover Xinghua, Tongzhou, Guozhou, Guizhou, Dingyuan and the rest, building a new fort at Baozhou east of the river and pushing the line forward. In strategy the Liao was not without a weakness. Cavalry was its strength on open ground, but it was ill suited to crossing a river and to keeping a supply line alive in hill tracks, and once it marched deep it had to live on the summer grazing and on a great many horses and carts. Goryeo, for its part, bought time with a home defence, with the density of its crossbowmen and with the depth of its terrain.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的不是征服，而是邊界。高麗保住了自己的王國與王朝：1011年遼軍焚掠開京而終究退出，1019年之後契丹不再東征，1022年遼聖宗冊封高麗顯宗為高麗國王，等於以藩屬的形式確認了既成事實，而高麗以國王之名受冊、拒絕稱臣，成為此後兩國關係的固定格局。高麗在北方留下的制度痕跡最深：各州縣常置的弓弩手、各鎭的城防與守備，以及兵馬都統使在上軍使、中軍使、下軍使之下統一調度的體系，都因連年戰事而固定下來，成為其後抵禦蒙古入侵時可以倚賴的骨架。對遼來說，高麗之役的失敗把它的注意力推向南面，1004年的澶淵之盟正是在這種背景下與宋訂立的；對高麗來說，北方壓力暫緩，使它得以在宋、遼之間維持兩不偏的商貿與外交位置。東北邊疆方面，渤海遺民與契丹叛戶流向鴨綠江東岸，1018年甚至另立興遼國，1029年興遼國曾謀求聯高麗攻契丹，高麗不予響應；高麗收留這些流民，同時也把邊防的壓力接到自己肩上。最後是保州：遼雖然在軍事上屢攻不克，仍在江東建起保州城，兩國為此往來交涉數十年，成為最長的一項未決糾葛，直到1117年遼亡、1126年金廷將保州歸還，才算收束。
impactEn: What this war left behind was not a conquest but a frontier. Goryeo kept its kingdom and its dynasty: in 1011 the Liao army burned and plundered Kaijing and withdrew in the end; after 1019 the Khitans never came east again; and in 1022 Shengzong of the Liao enfeoffed King Hyeonjong of Goryeo as King of Goryeo, which confirmed the accomplished fact in the form of a tributary relation, while Goryeo accepted the title as a king and refused to call itself a vassal, and that became the fixed pattern of the two countries' relations thereafter. The deepest institutional traces were left on the Goryeo side. The crossbowmen permanently maintained by every prefecture and county, the garrison and fortification of the frontier towns, and the system by which the military commissioners coordinated through senior, central and junior commanders, were all fixed in place by years of war, and became the skeleton on which Goryeo could later lean when the Mongols came. For the Liao, failure in Goryeo turned its attention southward, and the Chanyuan treaty of 1004 with the Song was concluded in that context. For Goryeo the relief of pressure from the north allowed it to hold a position, in trade and in diplomacy, between Song and Liao without taking sides. On the north-eastern frontier, the remnants of Bohai and the Khitan defectors drifted to the east bank of the Yalu, and in 1018 they even founded a separate state, Xingliao, which in 1029 sought to ally with Goryeo against the Khitans; Goryeo did not answer. By taking these people in, Goryeo also took the burden of the frontier onto its own shoulders. Last of all there was Baozhou. Though it could not take the place militarily, the Liao built the city of Baozhou east of the river, and the two states exchanged envoys about it for several decades, so that it became the longest of their unfinished disputes; it was only settled in 1117 when the Liao fell and in 1126 when the Jin court returned Baozhou to Goryeo.
result: 三次用兵，三種結局。第一次（993至994）：遼軍渡江、破蓬山陣、進抵西京，蕭通寧在安戴鎮受阻後改用外交，雙方以平行方式談判，高麗只以國王之名受書而不稱臣，遼的占領止於江東數城，實質宗主權並未到手。第二次（1005至1011）：遼以復仇為名大舉南侵，1010年十一月渡江圍興化，攻陷郭州、安州與西京，1011年1月1日攻下開京、焚掠宮闕，顯宗南走；但興化七日不克、龜州與通州四野反擊、撤退時遼軍多溺死者，遼聖宗終於1月11日班師，高麗未降，遼亦未能在占領中建起統治，轉而提出歸還江東六城與顯宗朝覲兩項要求。第三次（1014至1019）：遼造鴨綠江長橋、建保州城，屢攻興化與通州不克，1016年一度深入至郭州以西，1017年圍興化九日無功；1018年10月蕭排押率十萬眾再攻，高麗以姜邯贊、姜民瞻二十餘萬相拒，三橋川與慈州兩戰之後遼軍全滅，蕭排押被免職，1019年8月議和。結論很清楚：契丹前兩次戰爭贏了戰場而輸了政治，第三次輸了戰場，於是雙方都回到江東，以保州為界線長期對峙，而此後的六十餘年，鴨綠江兩岸再無大戰。
resultEn: Three campaigns, three different endings. The first, from 993 to 994: the Liao army crossed the river, broke the Pengshan line and pushed up to the western capital; after being checked at Andae, Xiao Tongning changed to diplomacy, and the two sides negotiated on a level basis. Goryeo received the letter as a king and would not call itself a subject; the Liao occupation stopped at a few towns east of the river, and in real political terms suzerainty was never obtained. The second, from 1005 to 1011: the Liao invaded on a great scale in the name of vengeance, crossed the Yalu in the eleventh month of 1010 and invested Xinghua, taking Guozhou, Anju and the western capital, then took Kaijing on 1 January 1011 and burned and plundered the palace, while the king fled south. But Xinghua held for seven days, the countryside of Guizhou and Tongzhou rose and struck back, and many of the Liao drowned fording the river as they withdrew; Shengzong broke camp on 11 January. Goryeo did not surrender, and the Liao could not establish any government over what they held, so they turned instead to two demands: the return of the six towns east of the Yalu, and the personal appearance of King Hyeonjong at court. The third, from 1014 to 1019: the Liao built the long bridge over the Yalu and the city of Baozhou, attacked Xinghua and Tongzhou without success, pushed in 1016 as far as the line west of Guozhou, and in 1017 invested Xinghua for nine days to no effect. In the tenth month of 1018 Xiao Paiya came again with a hundred thousand men; Goryeo opposed him with more than two hundred thousand under Jiang Hanzan and Jiang Minzhan, and after the two fights at the Sanqiao river and at Cizhou the Liao army was destroyed, and Xiao Paiya was dismissed. In August 1019 peace was made. The conclusion is plain. The Khitans won the first two battles and lost the politics; the third time they lost the battle, and so both sides came back to the river and faced each other for a long time along the line of Baozhou, and for more than sixty years afterwards there was no great war on either bank of the Yalu.
